findings.reason: The original three standalone tiles contain no figure. A concrete map triangle materially clarifies which maps are composed and how Catalan counting enters the argument. In particular, a separate indexing row prevents confusing an arbitrary path-based bijection with the action of the algebra map on the normal-form candidates.
findings.action: Added a TikZ map triangle and a separate indexing-bijection row in Remarks, with explicit definitions and an explanation that injectivity still uses the ring-theoretic determinant argument.

correction: Added only an explanatory Remarks illustration of q, pi_n and S=pi_n composed with q, together with the two Dyck-path indexing bijections. Preserved the complete original source as a prefix, including frontmatter/status, statement, Facts, proof and original Remarks.

diagram_math_checks.objects_and_maps: q: R^(N_n) -> P_n(R,delta), pi_n: P_n(R,delta) -> TL_n(R,delta), S: R^(N_n) -> TL_n(R,delta). The last codomain is R^(D(n,n)) by the diagram-module definition.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Item step 2.1 defines q(e_N)=[N] and S=pi_n composed with q; F1 defines pi_n(u_i)=d_i. Read def-temperley-lieb-generator-presentation and def-temperley-lieb-diagram-category: these are precisely the presented algebra and the free diagram endomorphism module.

diagram_math_checks.relation: The triangle commutes: its direct diagonal F -> TL is the composite F -> P -> TL.
diagram_math_checks.justification: This is the definition S=pi_n composed with q in proof step 2.1, not an additional identity. The rendered q arrow points upwards, pi_n rightwards and S up-right, so all endpoints agree with the stated domains and codomains.

diagram_math_checks.relation: All three triangle arrows are surjective at step 2.1.
diagram_math_checks.justification: F2/step 1.1 give surjectivity of pi_n; F3 and F5 give surjectivity of q, and their composite S is surjective. No isomorphism symbol is placed on the initially surjective maps.

diagram_math_checks.relation: N_n <-> Dyck_n <-> D(n,n) are set bijections, both for semilength n.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Read thm-temperley-lieb-generator-normal-form step 1.2: normal-form block endpoints encode east/north paths in y<=x and east/up, north/down yields Dyck paths. Read thm-temperley-lieb-diagrams-have-catalan-cardinality steps 1.1–3.1: cyclic noncrossing pairings encode balanced bracket words, then up/down paths. The two-ended arrows indicate bijections with no relation asserted between these encodings and S on basis vectors.

diagram_math_checks.relation: Equal cardinalities alone are not depicted as a proof of injectivity.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Proof steps 3.1–5.1 use equal finite ranks to make the surjective composite a square matrix A, construct a right inverse B, and obtain det(A)det(B)=1. Step 6.1 derives invertibility and the isomorphism. Added prose explicitly retains this argument; the rigorous proof remains entirely independent of the illustration.
